# StatTile

The compact stat.

`LL.StatTile` · Components · Data

## Use

```jsx
<LL.StatTile label={…} value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.StatTile" label="{{…}}" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (StatTileProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `value` * | `React.ReactNode` | A number (formatted for you) or a formatted string. null shows "—". |
| `suffix` | `React.ReactNode` | The unit after the value, set smaller and muted: "%", "s". |
| `delta` | `number` | The change, as a signed number: shown as ▲ +4, ▼ −1.2s or ±0 (unchanged). |
| `deltaPolarity` | `'better' \| 'worse' \| 'neutral'` | Whether the change helps the player — from the game's rules for this stat, never from the sign (a shorter cooldown is `better`). Without it the delta is `neu… |
| `deltaText` | `string` | The formatted size of the change without its sign ("1.2s"). Default: the absolute delta plus `suffix`. |
